issue_context.title: Lightning: Change the Caching Mechanism in Pre-Info-Getter
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Currently, the pre-info getter in Lightning will use some cache some results from the context.  But that needs the developers to construct the cache manually.  So we need to improve the caching mechanism in pre-info getter, so that the caching is maintained automatically

review_comments: when is the `getPreInfoCfg.ForceReloadCache=fasle` used? I think we can remove this option.
This is to provide a mechanism to fetch the info again rather than use the cached value.  In case some devs may use it.    Otherwise they cannot reload the value once the value is cached.
Since it is an option, so it is backward compatible with the current code.  No need to do any adaptions for the devs.

It has not been exposed to the Lightning user, just an internal calling. The reason I think we can remove it is that we may don't need to reload the value at all for one `pre_info_getter`. It just cost the extra time for user.
